Class Hex32Coder

java.lang.Object
eu.cqrxs.crypt.encoding.Hex32Coder
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEncodable
public class Hex32Coder extends Object implements IEncodable
Hex32Coder encoding is a mapping for double hex from 0-9A-V (32 chiffers per digit), padding char is = invalid input: '<'a href="href="https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4648#section-7">Hex32
